#### Trustless payments

Quick writeup: https://hackmd.io/@tchain/payment-config

* Should we have trustless payments in the current EIP in the first place? Is it possible to separate so we don't have to decide the following points right now?
* If we are to keep trustless payments, how would that look in-protocol? E.g., should bids go through the withdrawal queue directly? What are the tradeoffs?
* How would off-protocol bids be supported? How and what should we standardize?

As a continuation of our ACDC call last week, I would like to talk about trustless payments in ePBS. I believe the following should be covered:

- Should we have trustless payments in the current EIP in the first place? Is it possible to separate so we don't have to decide the following points right now? 
- If we are to keep trustless payments, how would that look in-protocol? E.g., should bids go through the withdrawal queue directly? What are the tradeoffs?
- How would off-protocol bids be supported? How and what should we standardize?

> * How would off-protocol bids be supported? How and what should we standardize?

@linoscope I have a quick writeup here: https://hackmd.io/@tchain/payment-config feedback welcome

I'd like to discuss an eventual attestation container refactoring since the `attestation.data.index` is now used to signal the payload status of the block being attested to.
In Electra we agreed to set the index to 0 and now we're reusing it which introduces a conceptual change.
Even though the container still has the same data structure, the index field is interpreted differently based on the fork:
- Phase 0 -> Deneb : represents the committee index
- Electra: ignored and set to 0
- Gloas : could be 0 or 1 to signal the payload status

This have many side effects:
- The `/eth/v1/validator/attestation_data rest` api since in Electra we've introduced this change that won't be valid anymore:
https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/blob/master/apis/validator/attestation_data.yaml#L21
- The gossip rules https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/blob/master/apis/validator/attestation_data.yaml#L21 
- The attestation creation: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/gloas/validator.md#attestation

Reusing the same attestation container without introducing a new spec changes (a new Gloas attestation container) will likely introduce bugs and add complexity/confusion on how the index field should be interpreted.
